description: The line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across different experimental configurations, with the x-axis representing the iteration number ranging from 0 to 62 and the y-axis showing the mean interclass similarity on a scale from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot compares six different conditions: "w/o DPO obo" (solid blue line), "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (solid orange line), "DPO" (solid green line), "Average of w/o DPO obo" (dashed blue line), "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (dashed orange line), and "Average of DPO" (dashed green line). The "w/o DPO obo" line starts at approximately 0.22, peaks sharply at around 0.48 near iteration 1, and then fluctuates with several peaks above 0.25, ending near 0.02. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line begins at about 0.10, rises to a peak of approximately 0.45 near iteration 32, and then exhibits a general decline, ending near 0.08. The "DPO" line starts at around 0.19, shows a peak of about 0.19 near iteration 23, and generally trends downward, ending near 0.07. The dashed lines represent averages: the "Average of w/o DPO obo" (dashed blue) is a horizontal line at approximately 0.107; the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (dashed orange) is a horizontal line at approximately 0.158; and the "Average of DPO" (dashed green) is a horizontal line at approximately 0.086. The plot includes labels for these average values on the left side of the graph.
